{{Otheruses|ice}}
'''Nether ice''' was a major export from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> It was mined from Neftali's [[Water/Legends|ice fields]] and could remain in a frozen state for a long period of time due to unusual compounds in its structure. Small pieces of nether ice could remain frozen for up to a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] had been known to use nether ice to cool [[Engine/Legends|engines]] during emergencies. Although generally sold in bulk, nether ice could be bought as souvenirs and even customized into jewelry.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
